Claim 3 (currently amended): (currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference is based on a minimum desired throughput for each particular node, and wherein the minimum desired throughput is defined as a threshold value that each node aims to achieve for effective communication.

Claim 4 (currently amended): (currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage based on the indicia of inter-node interference of the first node divided by an indicia of inter-node interference of one or more other nodes that are interfered with by transmissions from the first node.

Claim 14 (currently amended): (currently amended) The system of claim 13, wherein the first access point is configured to broadcast a dynamic weight associated with the second node to the first node, and wherein the dynamic weight is determined based on the transmission success rate of the second node.

Claim 17 (currently amended): (currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising a second access point, wherein the second node communicates with the second access point and the first node interferes with communication between the second node and the second access point, and wherein the interference is quantified based on the access attempt percentage of the first node.
